svg.title: Fork Studio inside
svg.desc: Native shell, local server and modules, shared UI, Rust core, data and the flows out. 50 components and 37 flows.
svg.text: Native shell, local server and modules, shared UI, Rust core, data and the flows out

g.title: Fork Studio window — Built — Tauri v2 window, native title bar, single instance and Dev/Freeze builds.
Sidecar supervisor — Built — Starts the bundled Flask server on a free 127.0.0.1 port and stops it with the app.
Menus and permissions — Built — Tray, Save Version ball, global shortcut, Settings window, folder picker and permissions.
Updater — Building — Signed Tauri updater, hourly check and GitHub release feed; feed repositories to create.
Windows build — After beta — Windows installer, tray and updater; the beta ships on the computer first, Windows comes after beta.
Studio server (Flask) — Built — Local single-user server: SQLite, API v1, sessions and background jobs.
Library and import — Built — Projects, Palette Creator, Samples, Archives, whole packs, onboarding import and disk remap.
Versions and signed catalog — Built — Save Version, incremental block store, signed manifests and catalog.db.
Structure and report — Built — ALS tracks, clips and chains, loudness and an HTML/JSON/MIDI report.
Store (seller) — Built — Releases, editions, licences, receipts, payouts and WIP passes; checkout is off.
Music (buyer in Studio) — Built — Browse, buy and play other artists' releases with the same Fork account.
Samples and Loops — Built — Short-sound portraits, t-SNE map, Palette Creator and phone sample search.
DJ / Simulation Booth — After beta — Four decks, EQ, loops and hot cues; built and gated, not in the beta.
Network — Built — Sharing, invitations, presence, swarm status, Signals and network limits.
Network rooms / Playzone — After beta — Rooms, private chat and the 8-bit Playzone; dev preview, no backend yet.
Live Companion — After beta — Remote view and control of an Ableton Live set; built and gated, not in the beta.
Studio on the phone (/m) — Built — Remote Studio: projects, renders, palette and sample search over the P2P tunnel.
Settings and identity — Built — Preferences, artist key backup, shortcuts, appearance and network limits.
Feedback and error reports — Built — Beta feedback card, queued sends, error reports and remote switches.
Library backup — Built — Backup to iCloud Drive or a disk, verified before saying the library is safe.
Calendar — Built — Sessions and events linked to projects.
Assistant — Built — Optional Claude agent in dev builds; not shipped in the public build.
F909 index bridge — Built — Read-only bridge to the legacy F909 index in databases/f909.db.
fork-ui-py — Built — Shared Python shell, legal, account, network limits and the player bar.
ui-kit — Built — React tokens, AppShell, sidebar, dropdowns and tab group.
Shared footer and player — Built — Footer and player bar: queue, scrub, now playing and the update button.
Shared buying UI — Built — Store, library, checkout, receipts, wallet and playback fragments.
Studio API v1 — Built — Local HTTP contract between the page/.app and the Python server, with a service token.
Native IPC — Built — Tauri commands for audio, store, cloud, sharing, phone and updates.
core-crypto — Built — Authorship, catalog, keys, AES-256 at rest and artist key backup.
core-audio — Built — Native audio engine, DSP, loudness and the DJ booth.
core-daw — Built — Read-only ALS parser, chains, MIDI and analysis.
core-version — Built — Version diff for the project timeline.
core-rbexport — After beta — Rekordbox USB export; basic export written, real CDJ check left.
fork-daw-cli — Built — CLI for sample analysis and the t-SNE map.
core-p2p — Building — Rolling leases, chunker, block store, encrypted swarm and release protocol.
core-rtc — Built — WebRTC tunnel and tuned SCTP for the phone, with an ICE-lite host.
core-cloud — Built — Supabase REST/RPC client, auth session and the buyer bridge.
core-chain — Building — Licence and edition terms plus Solana Bubblegum v2 transaction builders; devnet.
fan-delivery — Built — Buyer-side device key, leases, passes, native bridge and heartbeat.
desktop — Built — Shared window chrome, Settings window, updater and sidecar launcher.
Supabase — Built — Postgres, Auth, Storage and Realtime: accounts, projects, versions, store and swarm records.
fork-signer — Built — Hot licence signer: Stripe queue, serials, Solana mint/transfer/freeze and key release; off by default.
P2P swarm — Building — Encrypted blocks on Fork computers and phones, three copies, direct transfers and release seeding.
Phone browser — Built — Connect PWA and Studio /m: browse projects, palette, samples and send files over P2P.
forkgate.io site — Built — Landing, beta signup, protocol survey, verify and licence pages, admin and /download.
catalog.db — Built — Append-only signed catalog of authorship records.
Block store and releases — Built — Encrypted blocks, manifests, GC and sealed release keys.
Keychain — Built — Artist key and device keys in the system Keychain; they never leave the computer.
Local data and disks — Built — Application Support, config, f909.db, project and sample disks with VolumeUUID remap.

svg.text: SHARED UI AND THE LOCAL API
RUST CORE: AUTHORSHIP, AUDIO AND VERSIONS
RUST CORE: NETWORK, CLOUD AND PLATFORM
